releases.name: Jokbet v0.4.0
releases.notes:
这一版把 Windows 上的悬浮卡片换成了亚克力材质，卡片本身也改成照着它背后的桌面来画。

- **卡片改用 Windows 亚克力。** Windows 之前给卡片的是「在桌宠自己的窗口上圈一块矩形做模糊」：它裁在桌宠的窗口里，跟着桌宠走得很糟，也说不出自己盖住的到底是什么。现在是亚克力材质——一个只属于卡片的窗口，正好裁成卡片的圆角形状，一直待在桌宠下面；它会把底下的东西透出来，卡片于是可以照着底下的东西来画。需要 Windows 10 1803 及以上。设置里的开关按系统实际的材质命名：Windows 上是「亚克力」，macOS 26 是「液态玻璃」，再往前是 vibrancy。

- **卡片照着自己背后画。** 亚克力从桌面取色，所以在这层材质上，面板不再跟着系统的深浅色走：它读卡片底下的东西，桌面浅就画深字、桌面深就画浅字，而且整张卡片上的字都用这一种颜色——固定的一档灰是面板可能漂离的那种颜色，桌面既不深也不浅时它更是没有地方好待。桌面杂到读不清时，卡片就多带一点自己的颜色。每次读数都是漂过去的而不是跳过去的，换字色也只换一次、并且是淡过去的，所以拖着桌宠走过花哨的桌面也不会闪；收起再出现时，卡片用的是它收起时的那个颜色，而不是重新读一次、当着你的面再纠正自己。macOS 的材质和卡片维持原样。

- **气泡底色默认改为 0**，也就是材质本身，全平台一致。

---

This release puts the hover card on the Windows acrylic, and draws the card from what is behind it.

- **The card is drawn on the Windows acrylic.** Windows' material for the card used to be a blurred rectangle cut out of the pet's own window, which followed the pet badly and had nothing to say about what it was covering. It is the acrylic now: a window of its own, cut to the card's rounded shape and kept under the pet, which shows what is beneath it through — so the card can be drawn from that. Windows 10 1803 and later. The switch in the settings is named for the material the system actually has: Acrylic on Windows, Liquid Glass on macOS 26 and vibrancy before it.

- **The card is drawn from what is behind it.** The acrylic takes its colour from the desktop, so over it the panel no longer goes by the system's light or dark: it reads what is under the card, and draws dark ink over a pale desktop and light ink over a dark one, with every word on the card in that one ink — a fixed grey is a colour the panel can drift away from, and over a desktop that is neither dark nor pale there is nowhere for it to sit. Where the desktop is too mixed to read against, the card carries a little of its own colour instead. Readings drift into one another rather than stepping, and the ink changes hands once, fading, so a pet dragged across a busy desktop does not flicker. A card that is taken away comes back in the colour it went down in, where it used to read the desktop afresh and correct itself in front of you. macOS keeps the material, and the card, it has always had.

- **The panel tint now starts at 0** — the bare material — on every platform.

---

releases.name: Jokbet v0.3.1
releases.notes:
这一版修两个问题，其中一个是崩溃。

- **开着菜单时不再闪退。** 更新下载好之后，程序会把「重启以更新」加到它和宠物右键菜单共用的那个菜单最上面——而且是在更新线程上做的，做的当下 macOS 可能正显示着那个菜单。macOS 对「显示中的菜单被改动」是直接中止进程的，发行版又是 panic 即中止，于是整个应用就没了。0.2.0 在 0.3.0 发布后一启动就撞上这个，因为它正要给自己更新。菜单建好之后现在不再增删任何项，AppKit 正在显示的结构不会再被改动；更新提示仍在——宠物气泡和「设置 › 关于」都会说，后者也是安装更新的地方。剩下的菜单改动（暂停勾选、隐藏/显示文字、语言）统一走主线程，发行版也不再 panic 即中止进程。
- **图表提示跟着你的光标了。** 鼠标划过每日趋势图，或者 0.3.0 新增的每小时活跃分布图时，高亮和提示框会落在光标左边大约两列的位置——y 轴的宽度被减了两次，一次是命中区域本身已经让开的，一次是那段计算又减的。这个偏差从统计窗口存在起就在了。

---

This release fixes two things, one of them a crash.

- **No more crash when the menu is open.** Once an update had downloaded, the app added "Restart to Update" to the top of the menu it shares with the pet's right-click menu — from the updater's own thread, and while macOS might be displaying that menu. macOS aborts over a menu changed while it is on screen, and the release build aborts on any panic, so the whole app went with it: a 0.2.0 install hit this the moment 0.3.0 was published, launched to update itself. Nothing is added to or removed from the menu after it is built now, so the structure AppKit is showing cannot change under it. The update is still announced, by the pet's bubble and by **Settings › About**, which is where it is installed from too. The menu changes that remain — the pause tick, the hide/show title, the language — run on the main thread, and the release build no longer aborts the process over a panic.
- **The charts' tooltips land on what you are pointing at.** Hovering the daily trend, or the activity-by-hour chart that arrived in 0.3.0, highlighted a column about two columns to the left of the cursor: the width of the y-axis was taken off the pointer's position twice, once by the hit area and once again by the arithmetic. It had been that way since the stats window existed.

---

releases.name: Jokbet v0.3.0
releases.notes:
这一版让统计窗口说得出一天中什么时候最忙，也让它能翻出更久以前的事。

- **按小时看一天。** 统计窗口多了一张每小时活跃分布图，跟着你选的 7/30/90/365 天来画，图下写明最忙的时段，逐个小时的数据也列在下面的表里。计数从现在起按发生的钟点归类；更早的日子在这里没有东西可显示，图会直说，而不是画一张空的出来。
- **看得比所选区间更远。** 原来四张卡片下面又多了四张：你最忙的那一天和它的日期、当前连续活跃了多少天、最长的一次连续、最近 7 天和再往前 7 天的对比。它们都跟着你选的指标走，也能够到屏幕上的区间之外。
- **多导出一个 CSV。** 导出会多写一个 `jokbet-hourly.csv`，一天一行、一小时一行。
- **更新说明不再是一串 Markdown 记号。** 「关于」里原来照着 GitHub 的原样印发布说明——两种语言、双语页脚、满屏的 `**` 和 `[链接](url)`。现在只留你语言的那一半、去掉页脚，段落、列表、粗体和代码都由页面自己渲染成文本，永远不会变成 HTML。链接只保留文字，因为点过去会把设置窗口带走。

---

This release lets the stats window say when in the day you are busiest, and reach back further than the range on screen.

- **A day, by the hour.** The stats window gains an activity-by-hour chart, drawn over the 7/30/90/365 days you pick, with the busiest hour named below it and every hour listed in its table. Counts are filed under the hour they happen in from now on, so days counted earlier have nothing to show here; the chart says so rather than drawing an empty day.
- **Further back than the range.** Four more tiles under the four already there: your busiest day ever and when it was, how many days in a row you are currently active, your longest run, and the last seven days beside the seven before. All of them follow the metric you pick, and reach outside the range on screen.
- **A third CSV.** Exporting writes `jokbet-hourly.csv` too, a row for each day and hour.
- **Update notes are no longer Markdown.** The About section used to print the release notes as they are written for GitHub: both languages, the footer, and every `**` and `[link](url)` in sight. It now keeps only the half in your language, drops the footer, and has the page render paragraphs, lists, bold and code as text, never as HTML. A link keeps its words only, since following it would take the Settings window away.

---

releases.name: Jokbet v0.2.0
releases.notes:
这一版让它懂得在全屏时让开，能用快捷键叫出来，热力图也照着你手上那把键盘来画。

- **全屏时自动让开。** 别的应用全屏播放、演示或者打游戏时，它会先藏起来，结束后再回来。不想要的话可以在设置里关掉。
- **全局快捷键。** 可以设一个显示/隐藏桌宠的快捷键，再设一个暂停/继续计数的，在任何应用里都能用。默认不占用任何组合键，到「设置 › 快捷键」里自己录。
- **界面语言可以自己选。** 跟随系统、中文或 English，菜单和各个窗口一起切换。
- **设置里多了「关于」。** 这里能看到版本号，可以手动检查更新；新版本下载好后能看更新说明，点一下就重启更新。下载完成时桌宠也会说一声。
- **热力图照着你的键盘画。** Mac 上画 Apple 键盘（MacBook 那种紧凑版，用过数字小键盘就换成全尺寸版），Windows 和 Linux 上画 PC 键盘；欧洲常见的 ISO 键盘也认得出。配色默认是 Jokbet 橙，也可以换成黄到红的热度色，深浅色模式各有一套。
- **托盘菜单多了「把桌宠移回角落」。** 桌宠被拖到找不到的地方时，一下就能拿回来。
- **出了问题会说出来。** 统计读不出来、数据库打不开、设置文件损坏，这些情况以前都悄悄失败；现在会明确提示，损坏的设置文件也会保留能读的部分。新增了日志文件，报 bug 时可以从「设置 › 关于 › 打开日志文件夹」附上。

---

This release teaches the pet to step aside for full-screen apps, answer to a shortcut, and draw its heatmap on the keyboard you actually have.

- **It steps aside in full screen.** While another app plays video, presents or runs a game full screen, the pet hides, and comes back after. A setting turns this off.
- **Global shortcuts.** One shows or hides the pet, one pauses and resumes counting, from any app. None is set until you record one under **Settings › Shortcuts**, so no combination is taken from other apps.
- **Choose the interface language.** Follow the system, 中文 or English; the menu and every window switch together.
- **An About section in Settings.** The version, a Check for Updates button, the release notes once an update is downloaded, and Restart and Update. The pet also tells you when a download finishes.
- **A heatmap on your keyboard.** An Apple board on a Mac (the compact MacBook one, or the full-size one once you use a numeric keypad), a PC board on Windows and Linux, and European ISO boards recognised. It comes in the pet's orange, or on a yellow-to-red heat scale, each with its own light and dark shades.
- **Move Pet Back to Corner** in the tray menu, for when it has been dragged somewhere you cannot find.
- **It says when something goes wrong.** Stats that cannot be loaded, a database that cannot be opened, or a damaged settings file used to fail silently; now each is reported, and a damaged settings file keeps what can still be read. A log file is new too: attach it to a bug report from **Settings › About › Open Logs Folder**.

---

releases.name: Jokbet v0.1.2
releases.notes:
这一版让 macOS 安装不再被拦两次，也让它的两个数字对得上。

- **macOS 一行装好，系统不拦。** 浏览器下载的安装包会被 macOS 拦下：dmg 打开时拦一次，里面的 app 再拦一次。在终端运行 `curl -fsSL https://jokbet.jokerben.top/install.sh | sh` 就没有这一步——它下载最新版、核对校验值、装进「应用程序」并打开；再跑一次就是更新。
- **macOS 多了一个 zip。** 不想用终端的话，zip 只会被拦一次（dmg 是两次）。下载页两个都列着，并写明各会被拦几次。
- **不再戴眼罩。** 之前开着「安全键盘输入」时它会戴上眼罩，但那时候点击、鼠标和修饰键其实还在计数——眼罩在说谎。现在只有真的什么都看不到（没给「输入监控」权限）才会一脸问号。安全输入期间普通按键确实不计数，这点在 [关于](https://jokbet.jokerben.top/about) 里写明了。
- **里程碑和头顶计数的口径一致。** 内置的当天／累计里程碑原来只数按键，而头顶计数默认是「按键+点击」，两个数字会打架；现在两者用同一个设置。统计页也多了一个「按键+点击」的选项。

---

This release gets macOS past Gatekeeper's two stops, and makes the pet's two numbers agree.

- **One line on a Mac, and nothing stops it.** A browser download is stopped twice by macOS: once for the disk image, once for the app inside it. `curl -fsSL https://jokbet.jokerben.top/install.sh | sh` in Terminal skips all of it — it downloads the newest release, checks its SHA-256, installs it in Applications and opens it; run it again to update.
- **macOS also ships as a zip.** If you would rather not use Terminal, a zip is stopped once (a disk image twice). The download page lists both and says how many stops each costs.
- **The blindfold is gone.** The pet used to wear one while macOS Secure Keyboard Entry was on, yet clicks, the mouse and the modifier keys were still being counted — the blindfold was lying. Now it only looks baffled when it really cannot see anything (no Input Monitoring permission). Ordinary keys typed during Secure Input are still not counted, which [About](https://jokbet.jokerben.top/about) says plainly.
- **Milestones count what the head counter counts.** The built-in daily and all-time milestones used to count key presses only while the head counter defaulted to keys + clicks, so the two numbers disagreed; they now come from the same setting. The stats page gained the same keys + clicks option.

---

releases.name: Jokbet v0.1.0
releases.notes:
第一个公开版本。

**它会做什么**

- 统计键盘和鼠标：每个键按了几次、左中右键点击、滚动手势、鼠标移动距离，按天保存
- 头顶一个数字：今天的次数或每秒速度，可以选键盘、鼠标或两者合计
- 光标停在它身上看今天的数据，右键或托盘图标打开菜单
- 你打字时它掏出笔记本一起敲，点到它、滚动页面都有反应，眼睛跟着你的光标转，你走开它就睡，戳一下会有反应
- 空闲时会踢球或东张西望，单击和双击的反应也能自己挑
- 中英双语，跟随系统语言

**隐私**

只保存计数：每个键按了几次、点击、滚动手势和鼠标移动距离。不记录输入内容，也不记录按键顺序。所有数据只存在本机。

**安装**

安装包没有 Apple 或微软的签名，第一次打开会被系统拦下，按 [README](https://github.com/sparkjokerben/jokbet#install) 里的步骤放行。macOS 上还要授予「输入监控」权限，否则它只会一脸问号。

---

First public release.

- Counts key presses (per key), left/right/middle clicks, scroll gestures and mouse travel, stored per day
- A number above its head: today's count or the live per-second speed, from the keyboard, the mouse or both
- Hover it for today's stats; right-click, or use the tray icon, for the menu
- It gets out a laptop and types along with you, reacts to clicks and scrolling, follows your cursor with its eyes, falls asleep when you are away, and likes being poked
- Juggles a soccer ball or looks around while idle; pick what a single click and a double click do
- Bilingual UI, following the system language
- Only counts are stored — never what you type, nor the order of your key presses — and they stay on your machine

---
